fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the function.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer, set by the function.

fields.name: WorkspaceId
fields.description: The organization (Workspace.ItemId) the payment is for.

fields.name: UserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the person who started the checkout (system for renewals).

fields.name: UserEmail
fields.description: E-mail of that person, for the receipt.

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: new|upgrade|renewal.

fields.name: PlanKey
fields.description: Plan.Key paid for.

fields.name: FromPlanKey
fields.description: Plan.Key before an upgrade (empty otherwise).

fields.name: Provider
fields.description: Payment provider: coupon|blocks.

fields.name: ProviderRef
fields.description: The provider's reference (checkout/session/invoice id); never a secret.

fields.name: AmountUsd
fields.description: Due before codes, USD (monthly price, or the prorated difference of an upgrade).

fields.name: DiscountUsd
fields.description: Taken off by the code, USD.

fields.name: PaidUsd
fields.description: Collected by the provider, USD (0 when a code paid it all).

fields.name: CreditUsd
fields.description: Credit granted with this payment, USD.

fields.name: CouponCode
fields.description: The code applied (empty: none).

fields.name: Status
fields.description: open|paid|failed|expired|cancelled|refunded.

fields.name: ReceiptNo
fields.description: Receipt number of a paid payment (MF-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX).

fields.name: PeriodStart
fields.description: ISO start of the period paid.

fields.name: PeriodEnd
fields.description: ISO end of the period paid (the renewal day).

fields.name: PaidThroughAt
fields.description: ISO instant the code pays the plan through (empty: not paid ahead by a code).

fields.name: PaidAt
fields.description: ISO time the payment was settled.

fields.name: ExpiresAt
fields.description: ISO time an open checkout stops being answered again.

fields.name: Note
fields.description: Plain note (e.g. why a payment failed).

fields.name: DetailJson
fields.description: Server-written details (the code's terms, proration).

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key, set by the server; unique index.
